para.text: This at first sight useless procedure is developed for special situations like presenting simulation results. Many simulations are carried out by following some process with very small time steps (increments). This finally produces a large set of data, that in many cases produce a simple smooth curve. This curve consists of many small parts, each smaller than a single pixel.
